title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani witnesses a boy about to tell Anbu a crucial truth, only for his mother to stop him. Her attempt to confront them ends in frustration as they make a quick escape.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi offers a free batter to an Ashram, but Siddharth poisons it. Later, she faints after eating a Dosa, prompting a panicked Paraman to rush her to the hospital.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri clashes with Sandhya over her public rudeness, unaware she is his boss. Despite her reluctance, Sandhya hires him at Vethanayagam's insistence, secretly plotting revenge.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Thenmozhi taunts Poongodi while Deivanai misguides Meenatchi. Meanwhile, Meenatchi rejects Poongodi's apology and Pechi advises Poongodi on her past mistakes.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Lakshmi urges Ragavan to stick to his diet, but he pays no heed. Later, Suresh apologises to Mathi for his harsh behaviour and assures her that he had no role in her job loss.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Nandhini asks Thangamayil to move out after her mother-in-law dies. Left stranded, Thangamayil hides it from Muthusudar, while Meena and others pity her plight.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Manohar sends Das and Pandian to Patna to bring Chandayatha's family. Chozhan prepares Aneesh for their arrival, while Nila urges Pallavan to get ready.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Shruthi opposes Ravi's desire for a child, urging him to settle their life and clear debts before parenthood. Meanwhile, Rekha's parents surprise Sathya with a luxury car.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Sethupathi suspects foul play behind the tender loss and confides in Rajangam. Meanwhile, Tamizhselvi grows tense as the loan amount is not credited to her account.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Arjun kneels before Madhu and sincerely apologises for his actions, but she refuses to believe him. Karthik takes Kasthuri shopping for dresses with Saranya and Arjun's help.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Karthikeyan and Shanmugam confront the family about the secret Biryani feast and demand money to get their share. Indhira and Murugan sneak away for a refreshing buttermilk treat.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: Contestants Are Back to School
description: The School Task turns chaotic with hilarious classroom moments, arguments and mischief as contestants struggle to stay in character and impress the judges.
